context: Ruled on the oracle-rulings appendix: 7 lead decisions + 7 conflicts resolved; added the `reinstated` lifecycle kind (rule capability, class-ranked) for C14 intentional restoration; ADR §2.3/§4.1/§4.3/§4.4/§12/§13 updated; oracle files gained their missing structured open-question sections.
rationale: C14 requires intentional restoration to be explicit and distinct from a historical view; the C14 oracle's positive control P1 restores a superseded record, which no existing kind allowed without contradicting §4.4's 'a restored superseded stays superseded' (which C16 depends on). A separate, rule-gated, class-ranked kind satisfies both cases without weakening either.
summary: Added a `reinstated` lifecycle kind (target, reason; requires `rule` capability; class-ranked against the SUPERSEDING event's class) as the only path by which a superseded or overridden record becomes applicable again; `restored` (from archive) keeps ADR §4.4 semantics and never implies `promoted`
